question_as_asked: Which of these artists have designed a card in the set Coldsnap, Jeremy Jarvis, Aaron Miller or Chippy?

question.question_text: Which of these artists have designed a card in the set Coldsnap, Jeremy Jarvis, Aaron Miller or Chippy?
question.evidence_text: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'; Jeremy Jarvis, Aaron Miller or Chippy are the name of artists which refers to artist IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller','Chippy');

executed_sql: SELECT T1.artist FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE (T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.artist = 'Chippy') OR (T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.artist = 'Aaron Miller') OR (T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.artist = 'Jeremy Jarvis') GROUP BY T1.artist
